items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: like Rex Stewart went out and got a pair of clunky shoes like Louis used to wear

ctx.x: But if you think about it, like for instance when Louis was with Fletcher Henderson’s band in the early 20s, and he turned everybody around just like Charlie Parker did later. And everybody wanted to be like Louis Armstrong. And I read, you probably read this, like Rex Stewart went out and got a pair of clunky shoes like Louis used to wear. And Rex said, “Yeah I used to try to walk like him and dress like him and play like him and I wanted to be him.”

They tell me when Louis went to Chicago he had like a box back coat, which had gone out of style, and everybody started wearing box back coats. I probably would have done it myself when you think about it.
